text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
The way the wrestlers fought to stay in
the ring
while teetering on the edge...
Hm, I feel like I
could use those methods
in my racing...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I'll need to review the recording again
tonight... if
I want to make that happen...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah... I should watch... some of my
dad's
matches... that I recorded before...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O ends up getting very
little rest.
